decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Opalescence and either Parallax Tide or Parallax Wave, allowing you to exile all of your opponent's permanents and win the game. Attunement and Frantic Search help dig for these key pieces, while Replenish allows you to bring back any enchantments that end up in your graveyard. Tsabo's Web and Seal of Cleansing provide some disruption and Stifle can disrupt your opponent's strategy. The mana base is set up to support the combo and ensure you can cast your spells on time.

The main idea of the deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's hand and board by using disruptive spells like Duress and Chain of Smog, removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Skittering Skirge. The Rack is used as a win condition to punish opponents for having fewer cards in hand, and Cursed Scroll provides additional removal and reach. Wasteland is included to disrupt opponent's mana base. The deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent through attrition and resource denial.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent by forcing sacrifices, discarding cards, and destroying lands. It also aims to generate card advantage through effects like Skeletal Scrying and Zombie Infestation. The deck utilizes a combination of removal spells, discard spells, and land destruction to slow down the opponent's game plan while establishing a resilient board presence with Nether Spirit and Mishra's Factory. Contamination serves as a powerful lock piece to further hinder the opponent's ability to develop their board.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly and aggressively put pressure on the opponent using cheap, efficient creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Wild Mongrel. By utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Wonder and Roar of the Wurm, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of countermagic in the form of Circular Logic and Daze helps protect the game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and maintaining momentum to close out the game.

The main concept of the deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal, and controlling spells. With cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Smother, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand and board presence. Additionally, the deck utilizes creatures like Ravenous Rats and Tempting Wurm to apply pressure and maintain board presence. The inclusion of cards like Phyrexian Furnace and Naturalize provides additional utility against opposing threats. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and outpacing the opponent through disruption and efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plays by countering spells, bouncing permanents, and controlling the board with cards like Powder Keg and Parallax Tide. The goal is to slow down the game with counterspells and card advantage cards like Fact or Fiction, while also pressuring the opponent with creature lands like Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory. The deck aims to establish control over the game through stalling tactics like Standstill and disruptive spells like Stifle, while eventually closing out the game with efficient threats and land destruction.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Sphere of Resistance and Pyroclasm to slow down the opponent's game plan. The mana base is built around efficient lands like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while efficiently ramping into powerful creatures to take control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of aggressive creatures and direct burn spells. The goal is to apply pressure early in the game and maintain tempo, utilizing cards like Ball Lightning, Grim Lavamancer, and Lightning Bolt to chip away at the opponent's life total. By combining efficient creatures with potent burn spells, this deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on setting up a quick and explosive combo involving creatures like Sutured Ghoul and Krosan Cloudscraper. It aims to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Buried Alive and Shallow Grave, then bring them back into play with spells like Corpse Dance and Lotus Petal. This combo can overwhelm opponents with large, powerful creatures early in the game. The deck also includes disruption and card selection spells like Duress and Sleight of Hand to help set up the combo. It is a fast, aggressive strategy that can win the game in just a few turns.

The main concept of this deck is to use enchantments to draw cards and ramp up mana, while also controlling the board with enchantment removal and the ability to exile problematic creatures with Parallax Wave. The deck aims to accelerate into powerful enchantments like Opalescence and Replenish to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Mirri's Guile and Sterling Grove help to filter through the deck for key pieces, while also protecting important enchantments. This deck is focused on establishing a strong enchantment-based combo strategy to outpace and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while simultaneously building up its own threats. By using counter spells and removal to control the board, the deck aims to protect its powerful creatures like Meddling Mage, Quirion Dryad, and Psychatog, which grow in strength as the game progresses. The inclusion of card draw, manipulation, and mana acceleration helps maintain consistency and tempo throughout the match. The deck's ability to adapt to different situations and outmaneuver opponents makes it a versatile and potent control-grow archetype in the Premodern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on creating a strong defense while simultaneously building up powerful creatures to dominate the game. By using counterspells, card draw, and efficient removal spells, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With cards like Quirion Dryad and Psychatog, the deck can quickly grow its threats and overwhelm the opponent. The addition of Mox Diamond allows for fast mana acceleration, while cards like Armageddon can set back the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck combines control elements with creature growth to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's resources and board state. It utilizes cards like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Smother to strip away the opponent's hand and remove threats on the battlefield. Contamination and Zombie Infestation are used to generate value and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Buried Alive and Nether Spirit provide recursion and inevitability. The deck also includes some aggressive creatures like Krovikan Horror and Mishra's Factory to close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards that can quickly fill up your graveyard, such as Attunement and Frantic Search, in order to set up a powerful Replenish combo. By casting Replenish, you can return all enchantments from your graveyard to the battlefield, including powerful cards like Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave. This allows you to overwhelm your opponent with a strong enchantment-based board state, while also having answers in the form of Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to deal with threats from your opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost and efficient creatures and burn spells. The strategy involves playing creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic early on to apply pressure, while also using efficient burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to deal direct damage. Cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional sources of damage to quickly finish off the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and constant damage to win the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Stasis lock to cripple opponents by denying them resources and preventing them from untapping their permanents. By using cards like Gush and Impulse to draw cards and find key pieces, as well as disruption in the form of counterspells and bounce spells like Chain of Vapor, the deck aims to maintain control while slowly draining the opponent's life total with Black Vise. The inclusion of Propaganda helps stall aggressive strategies, while cards like Forsaken City provide additional mana sources to keep the Stasis lock in place.
